work_handoff.title: N23｜Neil at the Open Door — Watches the Group Enter｜Candidate 01
requirements: Candidate 01 is NOT authorized by this validation-only spec. If later authorized, generate exactly one PNG and stop for Product Owner review.
The camera is inside the castle, deeper than the threshold, offset to one side, looking diagonally back toward the open entrance.
The group is moving from the doorway into the castle interior, generally toward the camera-side / deeper interior space.
The image must NOT read as people leaving the castle. Any first-glance outward-exit read is an automatic FAIL.
Neil stands at one side of the open doorway, remains at the doorway, does not touch or close the door, and has not yet walked away.
Neil side-glances toward the people entering; restrained normal butler demeanor only.
N22 canonical Story Shot is same-cohort continuity evidence only: clothing world, body proportion range, density, realism, natural overlap and warm-dark lighting continuity.
Do NOT copy, mirror or infer N23 camera placement from N22 pixels.
Guang Yong is tertiary continuity only; if visible, his body continues inward while head/eyes may retain slight backward attention toward the doorway/Neil.
Guang Yong must not become first-glance subject, foreground portrait, equal co-lead with Neil, or obvious speaking subject.
People should appear as 4–6 visible figures or partial bodies with natural staggered depth, unequal stride phases, backs/side-backs/partial profiles and no lineup.
REFERENCE ORDER DOES NOT EQUAL SCREEN POSITION, LEFT/RIGHT ORDER, BLOCKING ORDER OR PROMINENCE EQUALITY.
Castle Entrance Scene Master controls door identity/material/scale and DAY_DOOR_OPEN scene facts, not photography.
Preserve N22 warm low-key interior continuity: natural skin, restrained saturation, readable dark texture, moderate cinematic contrast.
Exterior light through the door remains controlled: no white portal, no broad floor light band, no exterior-dominant frame, no glossy mirror-like floor.
A06 remains later payoff: do not show Neil already walking away as the dominant action and do not show Guang Yong clearly speaking.
exclusions: Neil touching or closing the door
Neil already walking away from the doorway
Su Xiaoxiao / Liao Jian hero seeding reset
backpacks, shoulder bags, luggage or travel bags
horizontal N23 explanatory diagram or any generated camera sketch
